name: Steam Slop Rush
hook: Flood the Steam store with seven-fingered AI assets before Gaben notices
tagline: A frantic solo dev types prompts at hyperspeed while conveyor belts dump hallucinated textures, six-legged goblins, and robotic voiceovers onto the store page. Cashing out publishes the title into early access and collects bewildered wishlist dollars. Crashing summons Gabe Newell with a giant ban hammer that delists the entire publisher catalog.
